KIV-BE-015 — Copy any invoice into a new DRAFT ([*]→DRAFT, not a state transition).

New invoice gets a new id, invoice_number=null, issue_date=today (or override),
due_date=today+14d (or override). Copies customer, currency, lines (reseq 1..N).
Does not copy: invoice_number, issued_at, voided_at, snapshots, public_token_hash.

KIV-BE-016 — Rotate public share link. Old token immediately invalid (404).

Returns new raw token once — if lost, call rotate again.
Only ISSUED invoices; VOID → 409 INVOICE_VOID, DRAFT → 409 INVOICE_NOT_ISSUED.

KIV-BE-016 — Permanently revoke public link. GET /public/… returns 410 TOKEN_REVOKED.

Idempotent: revoking an already-revoked token returns 204 again.

get.description:
PUB-002/003 — Unauthenticated invoice view via opaque share token.

Security (Security.md:8.5):
- Raw token looked up by SHA-256 hash — never stored, never logged.
- REVOKED or VOID invoice → 410 TOKEN_REVOKED.
- Bad / unknown token → 404 INVOICE_NOT_FOUND (not 403).
- Rate limit: 100/min per IP+token (MVP: header-only advisory; enforced
  properly once Redis / PG rate-limit table lands).

Caching (API_CONTRACTS.md:13):
- Cache-Control: private, max-age=30
- ETag: "<content_hash>" from ISSUANCE snapshot

Side effects:
- view_state → VIEWED (idempotent, fire-and-forget).
- Emits invoice.viewed domain event.
